name: BNB48 private-tx MEV bot pancakeCall access control
summary: The bot trusted an unauthenticated swap callback caller, allowing a single transaction to transfer its six-token inventory out of the contract.
notes: The bot is directly deployed. Its 7,435-byte runtime is absent one block before creation and has code hash 0xa9093034826a8b019fa069caf0368a1a22de1d811b787dff70f740d8d6cebb7a at deployment and immediately before the incident; both EIP-1967 code-selection slots are zero. The unauthenticated callback behavior is in the deployed runtime and does not depend on a later configuration change.

Gross loss is the exact net ERC-20 depletion of bot contract 0x64dd59d6c7f09dc05b472ce5cb961b6e10106e1d in the single successful incident receipt. It sends 25,912.948173777791158265 USDT, 22,307.554466878046228172 BUSD, 5,160.324984279773039298 USDC, 327.931283327916980816 WBNB, 0.014990282011559361 BTCB, and 0.097450591261976269 ETH, with zero inbound or returned units of any component. Stablecoins are valued at par. The closest preceding DefiLlama observations are BNB $285.3866866195567 at 1663074301, BTC $21,447.84909779573 at 1663074388, and ETH $1,636.5916335063653 at 1663074373, respectively 139, 52, and 67 seconds before the incident. Gas and later recovery are not deducted from gross victim depletion.

The 0x64dd59d6 runtime is not source-verified on BscScan; its callback behavior was established from the deployed runtime's incident execution, cross-read against the commit-pinned technical reproduction and published analysis.
Replaces the seed's rounded $147,449 estimate with exact six-token contract depletion and independently preceding prices for every non-stable component.
